name: VBO Add To Wishlist
description: Views Bulk Operations action that adds multiple selected Commerce products to the current user's Commerce Wishlist at once.
project_description:
VBO Add To My Wishlist module provides the feature of add multiple product items into my wishlist.

 This module will work with VBO, Drupal Commerce and Commerce Wishlist.

 Configuration steps - 

 
 enable this module same as other drupal modules (VBO and Drupal Commerce must be enabled) 
 Edit your product list view 
 Add "field: Global: Views bulk operations" field 
 Open SELECTED ACTIONS 
 Check "VBO add to wishlist action" and give your label 
 save field and save view
